items.html: *And behold, the cause of two complete posteriors being made for them now was in this manner. For through the commandments and good deeds of the lower man he caused an upper coupling in AVI [Aba ve Ima], and they returned to give ZON other Mochin, which are the Hassadim and Gevurot of the Da’at of ZA, and these are the principal secret of the drop that AVI give in their coupling. And the reason is that the two Mochin of ZA, called Hochma and Bina — their lights are not revealed in ZA, for they are clothed in the secret of Netzah and Hod of Ima, and there emerges from them only a scant illumination, by force of the striking of the revealed lights of Hassadim, which strike them and draw out some illumination from them outward, as is known. This is not so with the Hassadim and Gevurot that clothe inside the Yesod of Ima, which ends at the Chazeh [chest] of ZA; for from there they are revealed in complete revelation and go outward inside ZA and shine in it. Therefore the principal ones are the Hassadim and Gevurot.
